transcript.text: fridge part freezin stuff, lettuce + yoghurts frozen solid at the back. hotpoint ff. any ideas pls

Also check the fridge setting is about 3–5°C (or roughly mid-way on a numbered dial) and that Super/Fast Cool is not on. Move food a few centimetres forward, especially salad and dairy, and leave space around any vents. If it still freezes food away from the back after a day or two on a normal setting, the more likely causes are a temperature sensor/thermostat reading incorrectly or an air flap letting in too much freezer air, which would need an engineer.
[Helpful to see: image "Fridge not cooling — simple checks first" — Before suspecting the sealed system, check the temperature setting, that the door seal closes cleanly, that there's air space and clean condenser coils at the back, and listen for the compressor. Unplug before cleaning at the back. A sealed-system or refrigerant repair is a job for a qualified engineer. Typical layout — your model may differ.]
dial is turned right up to max, kids prob moved it. and the fridge is rammed after a big shop, loads of stuff pushed against the back vent. will turn it down and clear it

Turn the dial down to a middle setting, keep a small gap between food and the back wall/vents, and avoid packing it solidly so air can circulate. Allow about 24 hours for the temperature to settle, especially after the big shop. If food still freezes after that when it is not touching the back or vent, a thermostat/temperature sensor or air flap becomes more likely and would need an engineer.
